name: Airwallex

webhook.algorithm: Two headers: x-timestamp and x-signature. Build value_to_digest = x-timestamp (as string) + raw JSON payload, HMAC-SHA256 with the per-notification-endpoint secret key, hex-encode, compare to x-signature. Timestamp IS covered, and Airwallex explicitly instructs you to then check now - timestamp against YOUR OWN tolerance (it prescribes no number — use 300s and document it as your choice, not theirs). VERIFIED from airwallex.com/docs/developer-tools/webhooks/listen-for-webhook-events.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN — Airwallex prices per market and per plan and publishes no single global card rate. Do not emit a number.

notes: Covers the two APAC markets nobody else in this list serves well — Hong Kong (FPS, PayMe, Octopus, Alipay HK) and Australia (PayTo, the new mandate rail) — while also giving a multi-currency treasury/settlement layer, which is what an APAC-selling SaaS actually needs. Its webhook scheme is also a clean timestamped-HMAC template.

SDKs: No broadly adopted official server SDK in the Stripe mould; Airwallex ships JS/React components (airwallex-payment-elements), mobile SDKs, and expects raw REST + OAuth-style access tokens server-side. Generate raw REST.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Stripe in SG/AU/HK/JP. Wins specifically on HK local methods, AU PayTo, and holding/settling in multiple APAC currencies.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
